He also describes benefits conditioned on having $100-funded people on both sides, urges participants to maintain at least $100, and cites a deadline and account consequences for not funding, while the dashboard shows referral, team, and bonus metrics.

The video also promotes income tied to left/right teams, direct referrals, and qualifying account funding, supporting S06 as a secondary recruitment mechanism.
